name: Alpengasthof Stillupperhaus
kurzbeschreibung: **Welcome to the cozy Alpengasthof Stillupperhaus in Mayrhofen, nestled in the heart of the stunning **Tirol** Alps!** Experience authentic alpine hospitality in a rustic yet charming setting, where warm wooden interiors and breathtaking mountain views create the perfect retreat. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, our family-run guesthouse offers a true taste of Tyrolean tradition. Indulge in hearty mountain cuisine—try our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy on the outside and tender inside, served with fresh fruit compote. Pair it with a glass of local **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** or a frothy **Schnaps** for the ultimate alpine experience. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the **Zillertal** Valley, unwind in our cozy lounge with a steaming cup of **Tiroler Bergkäse** fondue or a comforting bowl of **Käsespätzle**. Our terrace offers panoramic views of the snow-capped peaks—ideal for sunset drinks or a relaxed evening with friends. Whether you're seeking adventure or tranquility, the **Stillupperhaus** promises an unforgettable stay in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps. **Willkommen in Mayrhofen!**
beschreibung: The **Alpengasthof Stillupperhaus** in **Mayrhofen** is a popular restaurant that delights its guests with a diverse menu and authentic regional hospitality. The ambiance blends traditional Tyrolean charm with modern comfort, creating a welcoming atmosphere for any occasion. The menu features carefully selected dishes—from classic Tyrolean specialties like **Tiroler Gröstl** and **Kaiserschmarrn** to international favorites. The team places special emphasis on using fresh, locally sourced ingredients from the surrounding area. Whether you're enjoying a cozy dinner for two, celebrating with family, or hosting a business meeting, the **Alpengasthof Stillupperhaus** warmly welcomes you and ensures a memorable stay with attentive service.
